rows.title: The germinal main import reason page: Transit asks for the port of exit and destination country, Internal market for the purpose, and no exit date
rows.detail: The germinal products set has its own copy of the main import reason page. Its two reasons each reveal the follow-on questions the live-animals page asks for that reason: Transit reveals 'Port of exit' then 'Destination country', with the same lists, and Internal market reveals the purpose question. The live-animals exit date belongs to temporary admission of horses, a reason the germinal page never offers, so no germinal answer reveals an exit date and the set builds nothing for one. The live-animals page keeps its own exit date question.
acceptanceCriteria: On the germinal main import reason page, choosing Transit reveals exactly two further questions, 'Port of exit' then 'Destination country', in that order, each offering the same list with the same 'Select one' placeholder as the live-animals page. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-023, -p1-025; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p4-047-m1; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-082; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p3-040, -p3-047, -p3-050, -p3-056)

Saving Transit on the germinal main import reason page with neither answered shows 'Select a port of exit' and 'Select a destination country', in the error summary and inline on each field. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-082)

On the germinal main import reason page, choosing Internal market reveals exactly one further question, 'Purpose in the internal market'. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p3-018; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-023, -p1-025)

Each of the two reasons the germinal main import reason page offers reveals only the questions above, so no answer a trader can give it shows an exit date question. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p3-058, -p3-064; ruling:sam-2026-11-27 ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-005, -p1-006)
rows.notes: Already sits in inc-024 (the germinal start and its main import reason), whose criteria already state these reveals; this draft restates them so the combiner keeps req-2236 there. The 27 November ruling kept the default for the germinal exit date question: the set asks for none and builds nothing for one, and the live-animals set keeps its own (ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-007), which this row does not change. The last criterion states the complete set of reveals rather than naming the absent question.

rows.title: A germinal products draft is certified for 'Germinal products' from the start, shown on the review and published in the certified-for clause
rows.detail: There is only one answer a germinal products notification can have for what the consignment is certified for, so the germinal set never asks it and has no additional details page. The draft is created holding 'Germinal products'. The review shows it as settled information with no Change link, and the submitted notification publishes it in the same certified-for declaration clause a live-animals notification uses.
acceptanceCriteria: A newly created germinal products notification's review page shows an 'Additional details' card holding one row, 'Certified for', reading 'Germinal products' as plain text with no Change link, before the trader has answered any journey page. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-019, -p1-020; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-115, -p1-115-m1)
Opening the additional details page of a germinal products notification shows the page not found page. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-016)

Submitting a germinal products notification publishes the certified-for value 'Germinal products' in the GOODS_CERTIFIED_AS declaration clause of its published event, seen in the admin's outbox events view. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-019; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-115, -p1-115-m1)

sources.ref: §Live Animal Data Elements, row "Animals certified for": confluence-6497338582-p1-115, -p1-115-m1

rows.notes: Already sits in inc-182 (the rest of the germinal journey), whose criteria already state the created draft's certified-for answer, its review row and its published clause; this draft restates them so the combiner keeps req-182 there. No backend change is expected: the record already stores certified-for as free text and the publishing mapper already sends it as the certified-for clause, so the germinal set sets the value when it creates the draft. The value is set in the germinal set's own start rather than in the shared stub create lifecycle, which the split-off manage-notifications theme owns.
